Augustin Reinhard Stricker.question: In early _____, Stricker resigned to relocate to the court of Saxe-Coburg, which then resided in Gotha
Augustin Reinhard Stricker.fact: In early 1717, Stricker resigned to relocate to the court of Saxe-Coburg, which then resided in Gotha. But he remained there for just a few months, as in July 1717, a new pasticcio Crudeltà consuma amore (Crudelty will consume love) was played at the Palatine court of Neuburg.

Augustin Reinhard Stricker.subject: Indian Literature & Poets
Augustin Reinhard Stricker.question: In early _____, another pasticcio, L'amicizia in terzo overo Il Dionigio (Friendship comes in threes or Dionysus) was premiered in Neuburg, which was probably his opus ultimum
Augustin Reinhard Stricker.fact: In early 1718, another pasticcio, L'amicizia in terzo overo Il Dionigio (Friendship comes in threes or Dionysus) was premiered in Neuburg, which was probably his opus ultimum. Shortly thereafter, he relocated to another Palatine residence, Heidelberg, where his son was baptized in December 1718 - incidentally, exactly a year after his now much higher esteemed successor, Johann Sebastian Bach, took office at the court of Köthen.
